name: NCUFC Legacy Tree Fund
summary: Tree-planting grants from the North Carolina Urban Forest Council for local governments, non-profit community groups and public schools, with a focus on citizen involvement and education.

eligibility.rule: Neighborhood plantings on private land generate public benefits
Street tree plantings involve homeowners along the focal street
School projects involve the student body in implementation
Natural area plantings are not arboretum-type planting
Arbor Day plantings are not tree giveaways

status.quote: The 2027 LTF Grant application process will open May 1, 2027.

opens.quote: The 2027 LTF Grant application process will open May 1, 2027.

applicant_types.quote: Any local government, non-profit community group, or public school can apply for a tree-planting grant.

geography.quote: helps urban and rural communities across North Carolina implement their tree-planting projects.

access.quote: The 2027 LTF Grant application process will open May 1, 2027.

window.quote: The 2027 LTF Grant application process will open May 1, 2027.

amount.quote: Historically, NCUFC has issued $5,000 grants to multiple organizations each year.

eligibility.quote: as long as the designated area generates public benefits.
Homeowners living along the focal street must be involved in the project.
The student body must be involved in the project's implementation.
Note, arboretum type planting is not supported.
Note, tree give away requests will not be accepted.
